name: fieldnotes
description: Fieldnotes: a shared text feed with an Express/Prisma API and a React/MUI client.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix blogs-server-main ci && yarn --cwd blogs-web-main install --frozen-lockfile
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web "npm --prefix blogs-server-main run dev" "yarn --cwd blogs-web-main start"
scripts.test: npm --prefix blogs-server-main run test:unit && yarn --cwd blogs-web-main test
